shared_elements: human figure in profile with elaborate headdress
glyph panel flanking a figural scene
low-relief figural scene with ornate costume detail
rectangular carved panel with framed composition
justification: Both surfaces show the same distinctive scheme: a low-relief scene of costumed human figures in profile with elaborate feathered headdresses and ornamented attire, set beside and framed by vertical columns of square, rounded-cornered glyph blocks read as a text panel. The main difference is that A's figural group appears to include two or more interacting figures in a more crowded lower zone, while B centres on a single principal figure with a smaller attendant/apparition, but this is a variation within one apparent iconographic tradition.
